βααλ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1168); Baal, a Phœnician deity (used as a symbol of idolatry). KJV: Baal.

βαβυλων.def: of Hebrew origin (H894); Babylon, the capitol of Chaldæa (literally or figuratively (as a type of tyranny)). KJV: Babylon.

βαθμοσ.def: from the same as βάθος (G899); a step, i.e. (figuratively) grade (of dignity). KJV: degree.

βαθοσ.def: from the same as βαθύς (G901); profundity, i.e. (by implication) extent; (figuratively) mystery. KJV: deep(-ness, things), depth.

βαθυνω.def: from βαθύς (G901); to deepen. KJV: deep.

βαθυσ.def: from the base of βάσις (G939); profound (as going down), literally or figuratively. KJV: deep, very early.

βαιον.def: a diminutive of a derivative probably of the base of βάσις (G939); a palm twig (as going out far). KJV: branch.

βαλααμ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1109); Balaam, a Mesopotamian (symbolic of a false teacher). KJV: Balaam.

βαλακ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1111); Balak, a Moabite. KJV: Balac.

βαλαντιον.def: probably remotely from βάλλω (G906) (as a depository); a pouch (for money). KJV: bag, purse.

βαλλω.def: a primary verb; to throw (in various applications, more or less violent or intense). KJV: arise, cast (out), X dung, lay, lie, pour, put (up), send, strike, throw (down), thrust.

βαπτιζω.def: from a derivative of βάπτω (G911); to immerse, submerge; to make whelmed (i.e. fully wet); used only (in the New Testament) of ceremonial ablution, especially (technically) of the ordinance of Christian baptism. KJV: Baptist, baptize, wash.

βαπτισμα.def: from βαπτίζω (G907); baptism (technically or figuratively). KJV: baptism.

βαπτισμοσ.def: from βαπτίζω (G907); ablution (ceremonial or Christian). KJV: baptism, washing.

βαπτιστησ.def: from βαπτίζω (G907); a baptizer, as an epithet of Christ's forerunner. KJV: Baptist.

βαπτω.def: a primary verb; to whelm, i.e. cover wholly with a fluid; in the New Testament only in a qualified or special sense, i.e. (literally) to moisten (a part of one's person), or (by implication) to stain (as with dye). KJV: dip.

βαραββασ.def: of Chaldee origin (H1347 and H5); son of Abba; Bar-abbas, an Israelite. KJV: Barabbas.

βαρακ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1301); Barak, an Israelite. KJV: Barak.

βαραχιασ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1296); Barachias (i.e. Berechijah), an Israelite. KJV: Barachias.

βαρβαροσ.def: of uncertain derivation; a foreigner (i.e. non-Greek). KJV: barbarian(-rous).

βαρεω.def: from βαρύς (G926); to weigh down (figuratively). KJV: burden, charge, heavy, press.

βαρεωσ.def: adverb from βαρύς (G926); heavily (figuratively). KJV: dull.

βαρθολομαιοσ.def: of Chaldee origin (H1247 and H8526); son of Tolmai; Bar-tholomæus, a Christian apostle. KJV: Bartholomeus.

βαριησουσ.def: of Chaldee origin (H1247 and H3091); son of Jesus (or Joshua); Bar-jesus, an Israelite. KJV: Barjesus.

βαριωνασ.def: of Chaldee origin (H1247 and H3124); son of Jonas (or Jonah); Bar-jonas, an Israelite. KJV: Bar-jona.

βαρναβασ.def: of Chaldee origin (H1247 and H5029); son of Nabas (i.e. prophecy); Barnabas, an Israelite. KJV: Barnabas.

βαροσ.def: probably from the same as βάσις (G939) (through the notion of going down; compare βάθος (G899)); weight; in the New Testament only, figuratively, a load, abundance, authority. KJV: burden(-some), weight.

βαρσαβασ.def: of Chaldee origin (H1247 and probably H6634); son of Sabas (or Tsaba); Bar-sabas, the name of two Israelites. KJV: Barsabas.

βαρτιμαιοσ.def: of Chaldee origin (H1247 and H2931); son of Timæus (or the unclean); Bar-timæus, an Israelite. KJV: Bartimæus.

βαρυνω.def: from βαρύς (G926); to burden (figuratively). KJV: overcharge.

βαρυσ.def: from the same as βάρος (G922); weighty, i.e. (fig) burdensome, grave. KJV: grievous, heavy, weightier.

βαρυτιμοσ.def: from βαρύς (G926) and τιμή (G5092); highly valuable. KJV: very precious.

βασανιζω.def: from βάσανος (G931); to torture. KJV: pain, toil, torment, toss, vex.

βασανιστησ.def: from βασανίζω (G928); a torturer. KJV: tormentor.

βασανοσ.def: perhaps remotely from the same as βάσις (G939) (through the notion of going to the bottom); a touch-stone, i.e. (by analogy) torture. KJV: torment.

βασιλεια.def: from βασιλεύς (G935); properly, royalty, i.e. (abstractly) rule, or (concretely) a realm (literally or figuratively). KJV: kingdom, + reign.

βασιλειον.def: neuter of βασίλειος (G934); a palace. KJV: king's court.

βασιλειοσ.def: from βασιλεύς (G935); kingly (in nature). KJV: royal.

βασιλευσ.def: probably from βάσις (G939) (through the notion of a foundation of power); a sovereign (abstractly, relatively, or figuratively). KJV: king.

βασιλευω.def: from βασιλεύς (G935); to rule (literally or figuratively). KJV: king, reign.

βασιλικοσ.def: from βασιλεύς (G935); regal (in relation), i.e. (literally) belonging to (or befitting) the sovereign (as land, dress, or a courtier), or (figuratively) preeminent. KJV: king's, nobleman, royal.

βασιλισσα.def: feminine from βασιλεύω (G936); a queen. KJV: queen.

βασισ.def: from βαίνω (to walk); a pace ("base"), i.e. (by implication) the foot. KJV: foot.

βασκαινω.def: akin to φάσκω (G5335); to malign, i.e. (by extension) to fascinate (by false representations). KJV: bewitch.

βασταζω.def: perhaps remotely derived from the base of βάσις (G939) (through the idea of removal); to lift, literally or figuratively (endure, declare, sustain, receive, etc.). KJV: bear, carry, take up.

βατοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; a brier shrub. KJV: bramble, bush.
of Hebrew origin (H1324); a bath, or measure for liquids. KJV: measure.

βατραχοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; a frog. KJV: frog.

βαττολογεω.def: from Βάττος (a proverbial stammerer) and λόγος (G3056); to stutter, i.e. (by implication) to prate tediously. KJV: use vain repetitions.

βδελυγμα.def: from βδελύσσω (G948); a detestation, i.e. (specially) idolatry. KJV: abomination.

βδελυκτοσ.def: from βδελύσσω (G948); detestable, i.e. (specially) idolatrous. KJV: abominable.

βδελυσσω.def: from a (presumed) derivative of βδέω (to stink); to be disgusted, i.e. (by implication) detest (especially of idolatry). KJV: abhor, abominable.

βεβαιοσ.def: from the base of βάσις (G939) (through the idea of basality); stable (literally or figuratively). KJV: firm, of force, stedfast, sure.

βεβαιοω.def: from βέβαιος (G949); to stabilitate (figuratively). KJV: confirm, (e-)stablish.

βεβηλοσ.def: from the base of βάσις (G939) and βηλός (a threshold); accessible (as by crossing the door-way), i.e. (by implication, of Jewish notions) heathenish, wicked. KJV: profane (person).

βεβηλοω.def: from βέβηλος (G952); to desecrate. KJV: profane.

βεελζεβουλ.def: of Chaldee origin (by parody on H1176); dung-god; Beelzebul, a name of Satan. KJV: Beelzebub.

βελιαλ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1100); worthlessness; Belial, as an epithet of Satan. KJV: Belial.

βελοσ.def: from βάλλω (G906); a missile, i.e. spear or arrow. KJV: dart.

βελτιον.def: neuter of a compound of a derivative of βάλλω (G906) (used for the comparative of ἀγαθός (G18)); better. KJV: very well.

βενιαμιν.def: of Hebrew origin (H1144); Benjamin, an Israelite. KJV: Benjamin.

βερνικη.def: from a provincial form of φέρω (G5342) and νίκη (G3529); victorious; Bernice, a member of the Herodian family. KJV: Bernice.

βεροια.def: perhaps a provincial from a derivative of πέραν (G4008) (Perœa, i.e. the region beyond the coast-line); Berœa, a place in Macedonia. KJV: Berea.

βεροιαιοσ.def: from Βέροια (G960); a Berœoean or native of Berœa. KJV: of Berea.

βηθαβαρα.def: of Hebrew origin (H1004 and H5679); ferry-house; Bethabara (i.e. Bethabarah), a place on the Jordan. KJV: Bethabara.

βηθανια.def: of Chaldee origin; date-house; Beth-any, a place in Palestine. KJV: Bethany.

βηθεσδα.def: of Chaldee origin (compare H1004 and H2617); house of kindness; Beth-esda, a pool in Jerusalem. KJV: Bethesda.

βηθλεεμ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1036); Bethleem (i.e. Beth-lechem), a place in Palestine. KJV: Bethlehem.

βηθσαιδα.def: of Chaldee origin (compare H1004 and H6719); fishing-house; Bethsaida, a place in Palestine. KJV: Bethsaida.

βηθφαγη.def: of Chaldee origin (compare H1004 and H6291); fig-house; Beth-phage, a place in Palestine. KJV: Bethphage.

βημα.def: from the base of βάσις (G939); a step, i.e. foot-breath; by implication, a rostrum, i.e. a tribunal. KJV: judgment-seat, set (foot) on, throne.

βηρυλλοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; a "beryl". KJV: beryl.

βια.def: probably akin to βίος (G979) (through the idea of vital activity); force. KJV: violence.

βιαζω.def: from βίος (G979); to force, i.e. (reflexively) to crowd oneself (into), or (passively) to be seized. KJV: press, suffer violence.

βιαστησ.def: from βιάζω (G971); a forcer, i.e. (figuratively) energetic. KJV: violent.

βιβλιαριδιον.def: a diminutive of βιβλίον (G975); a booklet. KJV: little book.

βιβλιον.def: a diminutive of βίβλος (G976); a roll. KJV: bill, book, scroll, writing.

βιβλοσ.def: properly, the inner bark of the papyrus plant, i.e. (by implication) a sheet or scroll of writing. KJV: book.

βιβρωσκω.def: a reduplicated and prolonged form of an obsolete primary verb (perhaps causative of βόσκω (G1006)); to eat. KJV: eat.

βιθυνια.def: of uncertain derivation; Bithynia, a region of Asia. KJV: Bithynia.

βιοσ.def: a primary word; life, i.e. (literally) the present state of existence; by implication, the means of livelihood. KJV: good, life, living.

βιοω.def: from βίος (G979); to spend existence. KJV: live.

βιωσισ.def: from βιόω (G980); living (properly, the act, by implication, the mode). KJV: manner of life.

βιωτικοσ.def: from a derivative of βιόω (G980); relating to the present existence. KJV: of (pertaining to, things that pertain to) this life.

βλαπτω.def: a primary verb; properly, to hinder, i.e. (by implication) to injure. KJV: hurt.

βλαστανω.def: from βλαστός (a sprout); to germinate; by implication, to yield fruit. KJV: bring forth, bud, spring (up).

βλαστοσ.def: perhaps the same as the base of βλαστάνω (G985); Blastus, an officer of Herod Agrippa. KJV: Blastus.

βλασφημεω.def: from βλάσφημος (G989); to vilify; specially, to speak impiously. KJV: (speak) blaspheme(-er, -mously, -my), defame, rail on, revile, speak evil.

βλασφημια.def: from βλάσφημος (G989); vilification (especially against God). KJV: blasphemy, evil speaking, railing.

βλασφημοσ.def: from a derivative of βλάπτω (G984) and φήμη (G5345); scurrilious, i.e. calumnious (against men), or (specially) impious (against God). KJV: blasphemer(-mous), railing.

βλεμμα.def: from βλέπω (G991); vision (properly concrete; by implication, abstract). KJV: seeing.

βλεπω.def: a primary verb; to look at (literally or figuratively). KJV: behold, beware, lie, look (on, to), perceive, regard, see, sight, take heed.

βλητεοσ.def: from βάλλω (G906); fit to be cast (i.e. applied). KJV: must be put.

βοανεργεσ.def: of Chaldee origin (H1123 and H7266); sons of commotion; Boanerges, an epithet of two of the apostles. KJV: Boanerges.

βοαω.def: apparently a prolonged form of a primary verb; to halloo, i.e. shout (for help or in a tumultuous way). KJV: cry.

βοη.def: from βοάω (G994); a halloo, i.e. call (for aid, etc.). KJV: cry.

βοηθεια.def: from βοηθός (G998); aid; specially, a rope or chain for frapping a vessel. KJV: help.

βοηθεω.def: from βοηθός (G998); to aid or relieve. KJV: help, succor.

βοηθοσ.def: from βοή (G995) and theo (to run); a succorer. KJV: helper.

βοθυνοσ.def: akin to βαθύνω (G900); a hole (in the ground); specially, a cistern. KJV: ditch, pit.

βολη.def: from βάλλω (G906); a throw (as a measure of distance). KJV: cast.

βολιζω.def: from βολίς (G1002); to heave the lead. KJV: sound.

βολισ.def: from βάλλω (G906); a missile, i.e. javelin. KJV: dart.

βοοζ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1162); Booz, (i.e. Boaz), an Israelite. KJV: Booz.

βορβοροσ.def: of uncertain derivation; mud. KJV: mire.

βορρασ.def: of uncertain derivation; the north (properly, wind). KJV: north.

βοσκω.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb (compare βιβρώσκω (G977), βοῦς (G1016)); to pasture; by extension to, fodder; reflexively, to graze. KJV: feed, keep.

βοσορ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1160); Bosor (i.e. Beor), a Moabite. KJV: Bosor.

βοτανη.def: from βόσκω (G1006); herbage (as if for grazing). KJV: herb.

βοτρυσ.def: of uncertain derivation; a bunch (of grapes). KJV: (vine) cluster (of the vine).

βουλευτησ.def: from βουλεύω (G1011); an adviser, i.e. (specially) a councillor or member of the Jewish Sanhedrin. KJV: counsellor.

βουλευω.def: from βουλή (G1012); to advise, i.e. (reflexively) deliberate, or (by implication) resolve. KJV: consult, take counsel, determine, be minded, purpose.

βουλη.def: from βούλομαι (G1014); volition, i.e. (objectively) advice, or (by implication) purpose. KJV: + advise, counsel, will.

βουλημα.def: from βούλομαι (G1014); a resolve. KJV: purpose, will.

βουλομαι.def: middle voice of a primary verb; to "will," i.e. (reflexively) be willing. KJV: be disposed, minded, intend, list, (be, of own) will (-ing).

βουνοσ.def: probably of foreign origin; a hillock. KJV: hill.

βουσ.def: probably from the base of βόσκω (G1006); an ox (as grazing), i.e. an animal of that species ("beef"). KJV: ox.

βραβειον.def: from βραβεύς (an umpire of uncertain derivation); an award (of arbitration), i.e. (specially) a prize in the public games. KJV: prize.

βραβευω.def: from the same as βραβεῖον (G1017); to arbitrate, i.e. (genitive case) to govern (figuratively, prevail). KJV: rule.

βραδυνω.def: from βραδύς (G1021); to delay. KJV: be slack, tarry.

βραδυπλοεω.def: from βραδύς (G1021) and a prolonged form of πλέω (G4126); to sail slowly. KJV: sail slowly.

βραδυσ.def: of uncertain affinity; slow; figuratively, dull. KJV: slow.

βραχιων.def: properly, comparative of βραχύς (G1024), but apparently in the sense of βράσσω (to wield); the arm, i.e. (figuratively) strength. KJV: arm.

βραχυσ.def: of uncertain affinity; short (of time, place, quantity, or number). KJV: few words, little (space, while).

βρεφοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; an infant (properly, unborn) literally or figuratively. KJV: babe, (young) child, infant.

βρεχω.def: a primary verb; to moisten (especially by a shower). KJV: (send) rain, wash.

βροντη.def: akin to βρέμω (to roar); thunder. KJV: thunder(-ing).

βροχοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; a noose. KJV: snare.

βρυγμοσ.def: from βρύχω (G1031); a grating (of the teeth). KJV: gnashing.

βρυχω.def: a primary verb; to grate the teeth (in pain or rage). KJV: gnash.

βρυω.def: a primary verb; to swell out, i.e. (by implication) to gush. KJV: send forth.

βρωμα.def: from the base of βιβρώσκω (G977); food (literally or figuratively), especially (ceremonially) articles allowed or forbidden by the Jewish law. KJV: meat, victuals.

βρωσισ.def: from the base of βιβρώσκω (G977); (abstractly) eating (literally or figuratively); by extension (concretely) food (literally or figuratively). KJV: eating, food, meat.

βυθιζω.def: from βυθός (G1037); to sink; by implication, to drown. KJV: begin to sink, drown.

βυθοσ.def: a variation of βάθος (G899); depth, i.e. (by implication) the sea. KJV: deep.

βυρσευσ.def: from βύρσα (a hide); a tanner. KJV: tanner.

βυσσινοσ.def: from βύσσος (G1040); made of linen (neuter a linen cloth). KJV: fine linen.

βυσσοσ.def: of Hebrew origin (H948); white linen. KJV: fine linen.

βωμοσ.def: from the base of βάσις (G939); properly, a stand, i.e. (specially) an altar. KJV: altar.
